Ending cash from the governmental funds balance sheet Total column (p3): cash and cash equivalents 207,527 + county treasurer cash 3,184; certificates of deposit 426,276 in ending_investments; no prior-year cash printed, so beginning_cash null. 'Licenses, rents, and fees' 3,318 split using the General Fund departments Total column (Licenses and permits 548 + Rental and fees 2,770, p12). 'Grants' 4,760 and Water Fund 'Grant income' 48,672: grantor not printed (category other, Grants). Street Fund Intergovernmental: highway allocation not printed (other state aid). Business-type from the enterprise funds Total column (p6): 2,658,082 + 936,343 - 849,648 = 2,744,777; receipts total computed (operating + nonoperating revenues); disbursements total 849,648 = SoA total business-type expenses (p2) = operating 811,222 + interest expense 38,426. Proprietary cash flows (pp7-8) printed but left null as in FY2023-FY2025. The cash flow statement (p7) and the General Fund departments statement (p11) are headed 'year ended September 30, 2021', but their figures tie to the FY2022 statements (Light Fund operating income 29,207, General Fund totals 239,497 / 195,766), so they are treated as FY2022 (header typo). Balance sheet: Statement of Net Position (p1), Governmental/Business-type columns (governmental funds balance sheet totals 636,987 differ from government-wide, which includes capital assets). Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining statement (pp11-12, department columns; more detailed than the General Fund budget schedule p9, which is not recorded); Street Fund budget schedule (p10); proprietary funds by fund column (p6; nonoperating items outside the printed operating totals).
